verdict.rationale: Cross-platform consistency is a fair question for a package-manager CLI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents npm running with the same workflow and config across macOS, Linux, and Windows. The config mechanisms shown (.npmrc, NPM_CONFIG_ environment variables, --key val switches) carry no OS-portability claim. The only platform-specific items are a Unix install.sh script and a Linux-only bwrap workaround, which is a user-side arrangement and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the same workflow and config on macOS, Linux, and Windows
